findings.evidence: Lines 48–55 assume only `[Bialgebra k H]` and select the topological component in `PrimeSpectrum H`; lines 139–150 only identify the same ground-field quotient spectrum. The roadmap explicitly requires geometric connectedness (`A ⊗ k̄`), stronger than connectedness over `k`, and its model for an affine group requires a Hopf algebra.
findings.fix: First establish the required base-change/geometric-connectedness result for finite-type commutative Hopf algebras, then define the identity component under `HopfAlgebra k H` and prove that its base change to an algebraic closure is the component of the geometric identity; otherwise rename and scope these declarations as only the ground-field component of an augmented bialgebra.
findings.issue: `identityComponentIdempotent` and all declarations derived from it use `connectedComponent (augmentationPoint k H)` on `Spec H`; this neither imposes a Hopf algebra/antipode nor proves geometric connectedness after base change, so it does not construct the advertised group-scheme `G°`.

summary: The construction selects the ordinary connected component over the ground field, not the roadmap’s geometric identity component, and it is stated for bialgebras that need not represent groups.
